1. About these terms

These terms are an agreement between you and TimeWarp (“we”, “us”), the provider of Timewarp. They apply when you create an account or use the Timewarp desktop app or our cloud services. Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal data. If you use Agent ID, the Agent ID Terms also apply.

A “consumer” is someone using Timewarp mainly outside their trade or business. Some sections apply differently to consumers and to business customers. Where they do, we say so.

2. Who can use Timewarp

You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding contract. If you use Timewarp for an organisation, you confirm that you're authorised to accept these terms on its behalf. In that case, “you” includes the organisation.

3. Your account

Give accurate information when you sign up and keep it up to date. Keep your password and devices secure. You're responsible for what happens under your account. If you think someone else has access to it, tell us right away.

Organisation owners and admins can invite and remove members.

4. What Timewarp does

Timewarp is a desktop app with AI agents that carry out tasks for you on your computer. They can use the built-in browser, your files and connected apps. You decide which folders, logins and apps each agent can use, and you approve sensitive steps when the app asks.

  • You're in charge. You're responsible for the instructions you give, for the access you grant and for the actions you approve. That includes messages your agent sends and purchases it makes for you.
  • AI makes mistakes. Output can be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Check it before you rely on it, especially for legal, financial, medical or safety decisions. Timewarp doesn't give professional advice.
  • Keep backups. Agents can create, change and delete files when you let them. Keep backups of anything important.

5. AI models and other services

AI models are provided by third parties: Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service), Anthropic, and OpenAI when you connect your own ChatGPT plan. When you use your ChatGPT plan, OpenAI's terms and your plan's limits also apply. We can't guarantee that any model will stay available. We may add, change or remove models.

Connected apps and websites your agent uses have their own terms, and you must follow them. We aren't responsible for third-party services.

6. Plans, credits and payment

Plans

The Free plan costs nothing and uses your own eligible ChatGPT plan for AI requests. Some models and features are only available on paid plans. Paid plans are billed monthly and include a monthly allowance of AI credits. Current plans and prices are shown on our website and in the app. Prices are in US dollars and include VAT where it applies.

Billing

You buy plans and credits in the app. Our payment provider, Stripe, processes the payment. When you subscribe, we charge your card right away and then every month on the same date until you cancel. When you change plans, the change takes effect immediately. We charge or credit the difference for the rest of the billing month.

Credits

  • AI requests on Timewarp's cloud use credits. How many depends on the model and the amount of work. The app shows your balance and usage.
  • Credits included with a plan renew at the start of each billing month. Unused included credits don't carry over.
  • Credits you buy separately don't expire while your account is open.
  • Credits have no cash value. They can't be transferred or exchanged for money, except for refunds described in these terms or required by law.

Cancelling

You can cancel your subscription at any time in the app. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing month you've paid for, and then your account moves to the Free plan. Apart from the right of withdrawal below, and unless the law says otherwise, we don't refund partial months.

Failed payments and price changes

If a payment fails, we may move your account to the Free plan until the payment goes through. We'll give you at least 30 days' notice before we raise the price of your subscription. The new price applies from your next billing month after the notice period, and you can cancel before then.

7. Right of withdrawal (consumers in the EU/EEA)

If you're a consumer, you can withdraw from a purchase within 14 days of buying it. To withdraw, send us a clear statement by email from your account's email address, for example: “I withdraw from my purchase of [plan or credits] made on [date].” You can also use the EU model withdrawal form, but you don't have to.

When you buy, you ask us to start providing the plan or credits right away. If you withdraw, we refund what you paid, minus a proportionate amount for what we provided before you withdrew, including credits you used. We refund within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal, to the original payment method.

8. Acceptable use

Don't use Timewarp, or let your agents be used, to:

  • break the law or infringe anyone's rights, including privacy and intellectual property
  • access accounts, data or systems you aren't authorised to use
  • send spam, run scams or spread malware
  • harass, threaten or harm others, or create content that sexualises minors
  • get around usage limits, credits, billing or security measures, or interfere with our services
  • resell or share access to Timewarp without our written permission
  • break the usage policies of Microsoft, Anthropic or OpenAI, which apply to the models they provide

We may limit or suspend use that breaks these rules (section 12).

9. Your content

You keep ownership of what you put into Timewarp and of the output your agents produce for you. You give us permission to process your content only as needed to provide Timewarp. For example, we send it to the AI model handling your request and store your synced chat history. We don't use your content to train AI models.

Make sure you have the rights to the content you give your agents. AI output may not be unique, and other people may get similar results.

10. The Timewarp app

While you have an account and follow these terms, we give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to install and use the app on devices you own or control. The Timewarp name, logo, mascots and software belong to us or our licensors. You may not copy, modify or reverse engineer the app, except where the law allows it.

The app includes open-source components under their own licences, listed in the app's third-party notices. The app may update itself, and some features need the latest version. If you send us feedback, we may use it without any obligation to you.

11. Availability and changes

We work to keep Timewarp available and secure, but we can't promise it will always be uninterrupted or error-free. We may change features to improve Timewarp, to follow the law or because a provider changes its service.

If a change significantly reduces a paid plan, we'll tell you in advance and you can cancel. If we shut Timewarp down, we'll tell you at least 30 days ahead. We'll then refund the unused part of any prepaid period and credits you bought but didn't use.

12. Suspension and termination

You can stop using Timewarp at any time and ask us to delete your account.

We may suspend or close your account if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms, if the law requires it, or to protect other users or our services. Unless the law or safety prevents it, we'll tell you why and, where it makes sense, give you a chance to fix the problem first. If we close your account for another reason, we'll refund the unused part of any prepaid period and credits you bought but didn't use.

13. Warranties

Consumers: you have mandatory rights under consumer law, including the Swedish Act on Contracts for the Supply of Digital Content and Digital Services (lag (2022:260)). If Timewarp doesn't work as agreed, contact us and we'll fix it. Where the law gives you the right, you can also get a price reduction or end the contract. Nothing in these terms limits those rights.

Business customers: to the extent the law allows, Timewarp is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind.

14. Liability

We aren't liable for:

  • indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data
  • losses caused by actions you instructed or approved
  • losses caused by third-party services
  • losses caused by events outside our reasonable control

For business customers, our total liability is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim and USD 100.

None of this limits liability for intent or gross negligence, for death or personal injury, or where the law doesn't allow a limitation. Consumers keep their mandatory rights. Business customers are responsible for claims from others that arise from their content or from breaking these terms.

15. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. For significant changes, we'll tell you by email or in the app at least 30 days before they take effect. If you don't agree, you can cancel before then. If you keep using Timewarp after the changes take effect, the new terms apply.

16. Law and disputes

Swedish law applies to these terms. If you're a consumer, you also keep the protection of the mandatory laws of the country where you live.

Please contact us first if something goes wrong, because most problems can be solved quickly. Consumers can also turn to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, ARN), Box 174, 101 23 Stockholm, arn.se. We take part in ARN's dispute resolution. Otherwise, disputes are settled by the Swedish courts. Consumers can also bring a claim in the courts of the country where they live.

17. General

These terms, with the Privacy Policy, are the whole agreement between you and us about Timewarp. If part of them turns out to be invalid, the rest still applies. If we don't enforce a right straight away, we haven't given it up. We may transfer this agreement to a company that takes over Timewarp, and we'll tell you if we do. You may not transfer it without our consent.
